rationale: M49 W2 (#769): the JS method dedup key was `${owner ?? "module"}:${name}` and scopeOwnerName only reports CLASS scopes, so every object-literal member of a module shared one slot — the second `init()` of a SIBLING object literal replaced the first, dead-spanning its body and losing its calls (probe: cfg.alpha.init's `one()` call vanished; TypeScript kept both). Contract: identity is container-scoped — sibling containers never collide, while duplicates INSIDE one container still collapse last-wins (family ruling Option A). Verified lane-visible on the real corpus: vue-element-admin MarkdownEditor/index.vue had MISSING={toFixed,random} from its two prop-default factories before the fix, 0 after.
